primarySourceSpans: HE Q4.2 complete primary context, PDF physical page 50
wholeDemandArgument: The full prerequisite compares selected plastic-production raw materials against sustainability, environmental protection and disposal. The ordinary-looking 4d partner evaluates plastics and metals with analogue/digital sources for sustainable development; the other ordinary partner 2cf is itself unsupported in HE.

The stock compiler marks 4d with HE mapping evidence. Inspection of the actual mapping shows three ancestor mappings, to Chemie, Energie und Nachhaltigkeit, and Q4.2; no individual mapping row targets 4d. Hence the apparently direct evidence is inherited source evidence, not a complete primary clause matched to the whole plastics-and-metals judgment.

The complete HE Q4.2 primary context covers fuel cells, plant-oil fuels, bioethanol, batteries, biodiesel and starch-based plastics/degradation. This does not establish the full canonical 4d partner and does not prove that broad plastic raw-material comparison is necessary for every retained source duty. HE Q2.2 recycling and polymer-production duties may support another narrow source role, but that work is not replaced by an inherited root mapping.

residualFinding.statement: Counterfactual stock closure success through 4d is not a verified primary full-demand anchor. Whole downstream scope and exact original operators must be joined first.

wholePartnerClassification.title: Acidität und Basizität mit induktiven und mesomeren Effekten begründen
Leitfähige Kunststoffe über konjugierte Systeme erklären
Halogenierung und Nitrierung am Aromaten beschreiben
Aromatische Verbindungen in Alltag, Industrie und Gesundheit bewerten

primarySourceSpans: C12-EA.5 content: Bindungsverhältnisse und Elektronenverteilung im Benzol-Molekül, Mesomerie-Energie/Grenzstrukturen/Delokalisierung
wholeDemandArgument: 4bdb requires both electron delocalization and the energetic stabilization of benzene using resonance. The actual whole b44f partner requires representing aromatic electron distribution, evaluating the status of resonance drawings as models, and assessing energetically plausible forms. The primary C12-eA.5 context explicitly names benzene bonding, resonance energy, resonance forms, and delocalization. Understanding that individual alternating-bond drawings are limiting models and that the actual delocalized benzene system is stabilized is necessary for that full model/energy assessment. This supports the whole 4bdb competence without adding a separate advanced quantitative orbital calculation.

This proof uses the full resonance/energy assessment partner, not merely an edge or the existence of a benzene illustration. The acidity/basicity, conductive-polymer, and health-evaluation partners are not interchangeable proofs: a linear conjugated polymer does not require mastering the special stability of benzene, and a health assessment can use supplied risk data.

All the selected C12-eA.5 primary clauses and the content items were inspected, together with the complete C12-gA.5 primary context. The gA context lacks an aromatic/benzene demand. This is not a claim that every possible BY gA source elsewhere was exhausted; rather, no exact gA full-demand proof was supplied by these downstream links.

residualFinding.statement: The current402 goal has both GK and LK tags, and there is no de-by composition view in the bound Chem view directory. The 24-tuple baseline therefore uses compiled-applicability fallback for BY. A jurisdiction-only registry entry would silently exceed the proved eA/LK scope. Bind explicit exact course placement or a genuine separate gA full-demand proof before accepting a DE-BY-wide registry entry.

nextNeeded: Preserve the full goal. Bind the eA/LK source/partner proof with exact course applicability; inspect and repair gA placement or provide a separate gA proof. Do not grant all courses from the current jurisdiction-only checker.

title: Polykondensation verstehen
completeDEDescription: Die lernende Person kann Polykondensationen über das Nukleophil-Elektrophil-Konzept erklären, den Aufbau entsprechender Polymere ableiten und Reaktionsgleichungen für Polyester oder Polyamide formulieren.
completeENDescription: The learner can explain polycondensation using the nucleophile-electrophile concept, derive corresponding polymer structures, and formulate equations for polyesters or polyamides.
primarySourceSpans: NI Q-MAKRO-NANO competency 008: economic/ecological recycling assessment (eA)
wholeDemandArgument: The prerequisite is the full three-part competence: explain polycondensation using nucleophile/electrophile chemistry, derive resulting polymer structures, and formulate polyester or polyamide formation equations. The whole downstream 8721 goal includes mechanical/feedstock/hydrolytic recycling, material loops, economic/ecological judgment, and source criticism.

The actual NI primary mapping clauses require describing a plastic recycling material loop and, at eA, judging economic/ecological recycling. A mechanical thermoplastic material loop and a comparison of collection, remelting, energy use and economic constraints satisfy those demands without deriving polycondensation mechanisms or polyester/polyamide formation equations.

Knowing that some polymers contain cleavable linkages can help a particular hydrolytic example, but it does not require every aspect of the whole prerequisite. Hydrolytic recycling is present in the broad canonical 8721 body, while these NI source clauses do not require it. That additional canonical demand cannot establish its own NI curricular necessity and then bootstrap the still broader full polycondensation goal. NI physical page 32 separately names polymerization and radical polymerization (eA), and application of reaction types to polypeptide formation (eA); neither turns the mapped recycling partner into a full polyester/polyamide nucleophile-electrophile proof.

residualFinding.statement: The sole actual downstream partner is source-linked only for a bounded NI recycling duty. The whole 9b942 competence is not necessary derived knowledge for that duty.

nextNeeded: Keep all original NI recycling operators and source cells. Supply a genuine full-demand primary/partner proof for polycondensation, or author an exact-scope route that needs only the legitimate recycling foundations. A country-wide removal of canonical 9b942 or weakening the goal is not proposed.

title: Eigenschaftsprofile von Polymeren
completeDEDescription: Die lernende Person kann erklären, wie unterschiedliche Monomere und Verknüpfungen zu Makromolekülen vielfältige Eigenschaftsprofile und spezielle technische Verwendungen ermöglichen.
completeENDescription: The learner can explain how different monomers and linkages form macromolecules with diverse property profiles and specific technical uses.
primarySourceSpans: NI Q-MAKRO-NANO complete row, including competency 006 on selected-plastic functionality
wholeDemandArgument: The whole prerequisite explains how different monomers and linkages produce diverse macromolecular property profiles and specific technical applications. The actual whole 2cf partner evaluates the significance of plastics and their production for everyday life, technology, economy and society. Its NI mapped source operators concern application research, evaluating use, sustainable recycling, and occupational fields.

A learner can justify an application decision from material-property and life-cycle evidence without independently explaining the full monomer/linkage-to-property diversity. Thus the existing requires edge alone does not establish the whole prerequisite as necessary knowledge under these exact mapped source operators.

The complete primary row also contains structure-based explanations of polymer classes and explaining selected-plastic functionality. That is scientifically relevant and may support a correctly bounded direct source role or a different legitimate partner. It must be examined against the full monomer/linkage operator and assigned source partners before acceptance; it is not silently promoted to complete coverage here.

residualFinding.statement: The exact existing closure through societal evaluation is insufficient as a whole-demand proof. Potential direct structure/function source evidence needs a genuine complete operator/partner join.

nextNeeded: Inspect the original NI polymer-class structure/functionality source cells and their current whole canonical partners. Provide an exact full-demand proof or a truthful partial/source-role repair; do not mark the current 2652 closure accepted from plausible topic overlap.
